mapper.insert: insert into reward_activity (id, status_id, creator_id, activity_type, reward_name, reward_desc, fan_only, participant_limit, winner_count, start_time, end_time, status, participant_count, drawn, create_time) values (#{id}, #{statusId}, #{creatorId}, #{activityType}, #{rewardName}, #{rewardDesc}, #{fanOnly}, #{participantLimit}, #{winnerCount}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, #{participantCount}, #{drawn}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select user_id from reward_record where activity_id = #{activityId} order by id asc

select rr.user_id as userId, u.nickname, u.avatar, date_format(rr.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as joinTime from reward_record rr join users u on rr.user_id = u.id where rr.activity_id = #{activityId} order by rr.id asc limit #{offset}, #{pageSize}
select rr.user_id as userId, u.nickname, u.avatar from reward_record rr join users u on rr.user_id = u.id where rr.activity_id = #{activityId} and rr.status = 1

select rr.id, rr.activity_id as activityId, rr.user_id as userId, rr.status, ra.reward_name as rewardName, ra.reward_desc as rewardDesc, ra.status as activityStatus, date_format(rr.win_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as winTime, date_format(rr.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime from reward_record rr join reward_activity ra on rr.activity_id = ra.id where rr.user_id = #{userId} order by rr.id desc limit #{offset}, #{pageSize}

select rr.id, rr.activity_id as activityId, rr.user_id as userId, rr.status, ra.reward_name as rewardName, ra.reward_desc as rewardDesc, ra.status as activityStatus, date_format(rr.win_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as winTime, date_format(rr.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime from reward_record rr join reward_activity ra on rr.activity_id = ra.id where rr.user_id = #{userId} and rr.status >= 1 order by rr.id desc limit #{offset}, #{pageSize}
select count(1) from reward_record where user_id = #{userId} and status >= 1
select * from reward_activity where drawn = 0 and (status = 2 or (end_time is not null and end_time < now()))
mapper.insert: insert into notification_system (user_id, category, content, related_id, related_type, create_time) values (#{userId}, 'REWARD', #{content}, #{activityId}, 'ACTIVITY', now())
mapper.select: select id as notificationId, category, content, related_id, related_type, is_read, date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime from notification_system where user_id = #{userId} order by create_time desc limit #{offset}, #{pageSize}
